title: Concept: OS command execution via Shell (vbnet) — review required
description: In vbnet, Shell executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (Process.Start with an ArgumentList and no shell) are vbnet-specific.
applicability: vbnet codebases that launch external processes through Shell; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
